Manufacturers Life Insur Co The has 48,625 shares. Sei Invs has 81,395 shares. Moreover, Wealthtrust has 0% invested in LendingTree, Inc. (NASDAQ:TREE).
Nikko Asset Management Americas Inc decreased its stake in Lendingtree Inc (TREE) by 33.57% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Nikko Asset Management Americas Inc sold 138,002 shares as the company’s stock declined 27.67% with the market. The institutional investor held 273,098 shares of the finance company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $89.62 million, down from 411,100 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Nikko Asset Management Americas Inc who had been investing in Lendingtree Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.09 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.30% or $0.75 during the last trading session, reaching $247.55. About 140,215 shares traded. LendingTree, Inc. (NASDAQ:TREE) has risen 66.73% since July 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 54.16% the S&P500.
Nikko Asset Management Americas Inc, which manages about $3.82B and $2.81B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Baidu Inc (NASDAQ:BIDU) by 76,941 shares to 288,891 shares, valued at $64.48 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Fiserv Inc (NASDAQ:FISV) by 185,892 shares in the quarter, for a total of 325,292 shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
Analysts await LendingTree, Inc. (NASDAQ:TREE) to report earnings on July, 26. They expect $0.76 EPS, 0.00 % or $0.00 from last year’s $0.76 per share. TREE’s profit will be $9.49M for 81.43 P/E if the $0.76 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.51 actual EPS reported by LendingTree, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 49.02 % EPS growth.
